name: Transrail Lighting Ltd
title: Transrail Lighting Ltd - 544317 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue +30% to INR6,880 cr with EBITDA margin 11.92%, but FY27 guided to ~20-22% growth and ~11% margin, and tower capacity expansion (1,72,000 to 1,96,000 MT) is near complete, adding supply.

utilisation.quote: installed tower manufacturing capacity to be more than doubled

capex.quote: Board has approved additional capex of INR203 crores in our Board meeting on 26 May 2026

triggers.label: FY27 margin guided ~11% vs 11.9% FY26
triggers.quote: we have given a guidance around 11% and if things stabilize and situation changes, we see an upside going forward

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth cut to 20-22%
triggers.quote: full year we will do 20% to 22% growth

triggers.label: Tower capacity to 1,96,000 MT by Q2
triggers.quote: increase in tower capacity to 1,96,000 metric tons and conductor capacity will double

triggers.label: Only ~30-35% of jobs have price variation
triggers.quote: around 30% to 35% of our customers are with price variation

triggers.label: New competitors entering T&D
triggers.quote: that will attract more competition for sure

triggers.label: FY27 order intake target INR10,000-11,000 cr
triggers.quote: This year guidance is INR10,000 crores to INR11,000 crores for new orders to come in

guidance.quote: full year we will do 20% to 22% growth
we have given a guidance around 11% and if things stabilize and situation changes, we see an upside going forward
This year guidance is INR10,000 crores to INR11,000 crores for new orders to come in
we want to further bring it down sub-80

prior_guidance_check.quote: we exceeded the guidance delivering 30% revenue growth for the year finishing March '26
against INR10,000 crores, we did INR8,520 crores new order intake

prior_guidance_check.metric: Phase 1 capex completion by H1 FY27
prior_guidance_check.quote: By end of H1 this year, we will finish both Phase 1 of capex

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue down QoQ; EBITDA margin 11.08% in Q4
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 11.08% in Q4FY26 and 11.92% for FY26

red_flags.label: Only ~35% of jobs have price pass-through
red_flags.quote: we have around 35% odd of our jobs have pass-through

red_flags.label: Labour shortage acknowledged
red_flags.quote: Yes, it's a challenge, I cannot deny that

evasions.quote: Don't look at the quarter numbers but look at the annual numbers.
